description.zh-CN: auto=自动定位（按网络出口判断所在城市，面板上会显示定位到的城市名和「自动定位」标记）；manual=手动选城市（在下面填）。定位不准时就改成 manual
description.en: auto detects the city from your network address and shows its name with an Auto-located tag; manual uses the city below. Switch to manual when the detected city is wrong

description.zh-CN: 只在手动方式下使用。填城市名，中文或拼音都行（南通 / Nantong），保存后自动解析成坐标；同名地点优先取国内的行政中心。自动定位偏到隔壁城市时，把上面的定位方式改成 manual，在这里填准
description.en: Used in manual mode only. A city name, Chinese or pinyin (Nantong); Chinese administrative centres win when names collide. If auto-location lands in a neighbouring city, switch the mode to manual and put the right city here

description.zh-CN: 快下雨时弹一条通知。正在下雨时不提醒，同一场雨两小时内只提醒一次
description.en: Notify before rain starts. Not repeated within two hours for the same spell, and silent when it is already raining

description.zh-CN: 1=未来一小时；2=两小时（默认）；3=三小时。接口是逐小时数据，提醒会落在整点上，文案里会写明是几点
description.en: 1, 2 or 3 hours. The API is hourly, so the alert names the hour it expects rain

description.zh-CN: 概率到这个数才提醒。30 更敏感、容易误报；70 更保守、可能漏掉小雨
description.en: Only alert at or above this probability. 30 is eager, 70 is conservative

description.zh-CN: 多少分钟取一次数。10=十分钟；15=一刻钟；30=半小时；60=一小时
